Package neqsim.process.chemistry.scale

Class StreamScaleAnalyzer

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.chemistry.scale.StreamScaleAnalyzer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class StreamScaleAnalyzer extends Object implements Serializable
Links the coupled multi-mineral scale equilibrium into a NeqSim process flowsheet.

Given a process StreamInterface with an aqueous (produced-water) phase, this analyser extracts the aqueous ion chemistry and operating conditions, runs the coupled MultiMineralScaleEquilibrium (barite, celestite, anhydrite, calcite, siderite competing for shared sulphate / carbonate / calcium pools), and converts the per-litre precipitated amounts into an absolute scaling mass rate (kg/day) using the stream's aqueous water throughput. That mass rate is the quantity that matters for process operations, deposition-rate estimates and root cause analysis.

Usage: 

 
 StreamScaleAnalyzer analyzer = StreamScaleAnalyzer.fromStream(producedWaterStream);
 analyzer.analyze();
 double bariteKgPerDay = analyzer.getScaleRateKgPerDay("BaSO4");
 double totalKgPerDay = analyzer.getTotalScaleRateKgPerDay();
 String dominant = analyzer.getDominantScale();
